proposed_fixes.title: Enabled modules sometimes reset after startup
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Startup may load stale or differently scoped persisted module settings before the runner finishes updating configuration, so enabled state differs between cold start and an in-process restart.
plan: Trace enabled-module settings from disk through runner startup and compare cold autostart with manual restart under the same user/elevation.
Correct the startup persistence or ordering path only where stored state is lost or read from the wrong scope.
Add a startup/restart regression test preserving enabled modules.
verification: Enable several modules, cold boot, and verify the same modules remain enabled without restarting PowerToys.

comment.body: Thanks for confirming the same-user setup and sharing that this began recently on v0.101.2362. Could you clarify which modules are affected and, after boot, whether their Settings toggles are actually off or remain on while the modules fail to start? Please also say whether restarting PowerToys restores them. This distinguishes persisted-setting loss from module initialization failure.
